openInSidebar: Open calendar and tasks in the right sidebar
openDock: Open calendar and tasks manager (right sidebar)
insertToday: Insert events and tasks into daily note
lang.name: Language
lang.desc: Follows the Obsidian interface language by default.
settings.serverUrlDesc: CalDAV root or calendar collection address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5232/
settings.passwordDesc: Stored encrypted with AES-GCM; the master key travels with the plugin data, so it works across devices.
settings.calendarPathDesc: Leave empty to auto-discover. Fill in a known path to skip discovery.
settings.connectionDesc: Test the connection first, then discover calendars on the server.
settings.noCalendarDesc: Fill in the server and account, then click “Discover calendars”.
settings.syncIntervalDesc: Set to 0 to disable auto-sync and trigger it manually only.
settings.conflictDesc: Which side wins when the same item was changed both locally and on the server.
settings.rangeDesc: {past} day(s) back / {future} day(s) ahead (affects fetching and the view range)
settings.enableRemindersDesc: Show a notification when a reminder time is reached. On mobile, in-app notices only.
settings.systemNotificationDesc: On desktop, send a system notification in addition to the in-app notice; clicking it jumps to the panel.
settings.dailyNoteFolderDesc: Where “Insert into daily note” writes. Leave empty for the vault root; the filename is always YYYY-MM-DD.md.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a number of 0 or more
settings.noServerFirst: Fill in the server address first
toolbar.showTodosInCalendar: Show tasks in the calendar view
toolbar.showEventsInTaskView: Show events in the task view
toolbar.showExpiredEvents: Show past events in the task view
toolbar.insertDiary: Insert events and tasks into daily note
toolbar.clickHideCal: Click to hide this calendar from the view
toolbar.clickShowCal: Click to show this calendar in the view
dock.nodateHidden: {count} undated task(s) hidden · Click to view
task.quickAdd: Quick-add a task, Enter to save (defaults to today)…
editor.needConfig: Configure and discover a CalDAV calendar in settings first
editor.aiParse: Detect dates and times in the title
editor.alarmEmpty: No reminder time set (no notification at start time)
editor.presetHint: Common combinations — click to add the whole set
editor.preset1: 1 day before + 1 hour before + at start
editor.maxAlarms: You can add at most {count} reminders
editor.deleteServerFailed: The server has not deleted it yet; it is recorded and will be retried on the next sync
editor.noDateInTitle: No date or time detected in the title.
editor.errEndBeforeStart: The end time cannot be earlier than the start time
editor.errNeedEndDateTime: Enter an end date and time
editor.errEndAfterStart: The end time must be later than the start time
catmgr.title: Manage categories
catmgr.empty: No categories yet — click “Add category” to create one
catmgr.hint: 💡 Use the ↑↓ buttons to reorder categories
catmgr.note: Categories are a quick-pick list in the task editor and are stored in this device's plugin data
catmgr.errNameEmpty: The category name cannot be empty
diary.title: Insert into daily note
diary.lead: Which range of events and tasks should be written to the daily note?
diary.range.weekHint: Monday to Sunday (week starts on Monday)
diary.range.monthHint: The 1st to the last day of this month
diary.range.allHint: Every past and future item, written into today's note
reminder.mobileUnsupported: System notifications are not used on mobile
reminder.engineDown: The reminder engine is not running (toggle it off and on to restart)
reminder.scheduled: {count} scheduled · {armed} item(s) with a reminder time
reminder.mobileNotice: System notifications are not used on mobile — only in-app notices
sync.serverChanged: The server address changed, but these calendars still point to the old address — rediscover them in settings: {list}
sync.pendingUnlock: Password is not decrypted yet (the key is not ready); it will be retried automatically
sync.secretBroken: The password cannot be decrypted (the ciphertext may come from another device) — re-enter it in settings
sync.noPassword: No password entered; fill it in settings
sync.discardLocal: “{title}” was changed on the server; the local change was discarded per policy
sync.storeSecretBroken: The password ciphertext does not match the local key (it may have been written by another device) — re-enter the password
sync.storePendingUnlock: Password is not decrypted yet (key not ready); it will be retried automatically
sync.storeSecretBrokenShort: The password cannot be decrypted (the ciphertext comes from another device, or the device changed) — re-enter it in settings
sync.storeNoPassword: No password entered; fill it in settings
sync.reconciledNote: Reconcile: removed {count} local item(s) that no longer exist on the server
sync.requeuedNote: Reconcile: {count} local item(s) were missing from the server and have been uploaded again
sync.reconcileSkipEmpty: The server list came back empty while {count} local item(s) exist; skipping reconcile
sync.reconcileRequeue: {count} local item(s) no longer exist on the server and will be uploaded again
sync.reconcileCleaned: Removed {count} local item(s) that no longer exist on the server
backup.title: Found your previous settings
backup.found: Settings saved on {when} were found: {host}. Restore them?
backup.hint: The backup holds only settings such as the server and calendars (the password stays encrypted). Restoring syncs right away. Choosing "Set up again" discards this backup.
backup.skipped: Old settings backup discarded — fill them in again
net.auth401: Authentication failed (401): wrong username or password
net.authFailed401Short: Authentication failed (401): check the username and password
net.principalNotFound: Could not locate the principal (non-standard server) — fill in the calendar path manually
net.queryFailed: Failed to query the calendar: HTTP {status}
net.listResourcesFailed: Failed to list the calendar's resources: HTTP {status}
net.serverChanged412: The server copy has changed (412 Conflict)
net.unreachablePlain: The request never reached the server ({raw}) — check the server address, port, and network
net.unreachableHttpHint: The request never reached the server ({raw}) — make sure the address is reachable on this device's network; for plain HTTP (http://) mobile may require https
net.transportUninit: HTTP transport is not initialized: the host must call setTransport() in onload. (Do not use fetch directly in the core layer — CORS blocks it on mobile.)
dock.title: Calendar and tasks
